turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Welcome, I'm Dr.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Aleman.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Since you're new with us, let's confirm your full name and date of birth.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Svetlana Petrovah. December 4th, 1979.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: And your new address?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: 4417 Juniper Ridge Drive. We moved here from Pittsburgh in August.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How's the move going?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Boxes everywhere still. But the weather is much nicer. I won't miss the snow. I'll bet,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: so I have the records your old doctor, Dr. Ostrowski, sent over. Tell me about your thyroid.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I was diagnosed with Hashimoto's in 2015. I take Levothyric Sign, 88 micrograms every morning.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How do you take it? With food,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: coffee.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Um,

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: honestly, with my coffee and my calcium, all together. It's the only way I remember.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Okay, that's really common, and it's important. I'll come back to that. How have you been feeling?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little more tired than usual, and I'm always cold. But I've also been moving furniture for two months, so who knows?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any constipation, hair thinning, or weight changes?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, my weight is the same.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Hair's fine. Any racing heart or palpitations? No. Your last TSH in the records from May was 5 .8, which is a bit high. And your cholesterol panel from May shows total cholesterol 248, LDL 164, HDL 52, and triglycerides 160.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Dr. Ostrowski said to work on diet. I'm not on anything for it.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any heart disease in the family.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My father had a heart attack at 58. He's stents any other supplements besides the calcium vitamin d 2000 units a day and a hair skin and nails gummy I think it has biotin the calcium is 600 milligrams once a day do you smoke never any allergies to medicines codine makes me throw up really badly got it your Your blood pressure is 124 over 78,

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: pulse 66, weight 158 pounds. Let me feel your neck. Thyroid isn't enlarged and I don't feel any nodules. Skin is a little dry, heart is regular, lungs are clear, and your reflexes are normal.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: So, two things. First, your hypothyroidism from Hashimoto's. The TSH was a little high and I think part of that is the way you're taking the pill. coffee and calcium both block absorption, take the levathuric sign alone with water first thing in the morning, at least 30 to 60 minutes before coffee or breakfast, and take the calcium at least four hours later with dinner is easiest.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh, I had no idea.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Keep the dose at 88 micrograms for now. I'll recheck the TSH and a free T4 in six weeks once you've been taking it the right way. Stop the biotin gummy three days before that blood draw because biotin can throw off thyroid tests.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, and if it's still high?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: If the TSH is still above 4 .5, we'd go up to 100 micrograms, but let's see first. Second, your cholesterol is high and an underactive thyroid can raise cholesterol, so I'd like a fasting lipid panel with the thyroid labs and then we'll talk about your overall heart risk, especially with your father's history. Meanwhile, more fiber, less saturated fat, and regular exercise.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: That sounds reasonable.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: I'll see you in six to eight weeks after the labs. Can I get an email for the portal?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sure, it's spetrova79 at example .com.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Perfect. Welcome to the practice, Svetlana.
